name: Play a land on turn 1-2 when nothing in hand unlocks anything
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once none of open-land-unlocks, open-shock-unlocks or open-fetch-unlocks apply and no other hand card is already affordable, still play the land drop - any land in hand beats holding it back with nothing to protect. Prefers a surveil land (Meticulous Archive, Shadowy Backstreet, Undercity Sewers) first and keeps the surveilled card, since it was entering tapped regardless and the scry is free value; then any other land that would enter tapped anyway, since playing it now costs no tempo it would not already lose; then a shockland, life declined, since paying for it buys nothing this turn and an idle land drop should not hold a shock back the way F holds a fetch (item 5); then a fetch, held for a target-rich later turn but taken here since nothing else is better and it can still crack for the end-step surveil play later. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack. Stands down once two or more untapped mana is already up: the seat-admitted orchid-phantom-breaks-tron play (eldrazi-ramp only) needs that much to cast the two-mana flier, and this land-drop decision is judged before that turn's land is played, so on a genuine turn 1-2 board this key costs nothing here - untapped mana cannot reach 2 before the first or second land drop without a mana source this deck does not run.
